configuration.network: Hermetic local file fulfillment; no HTTP server, CDN, public-origin latency or network throttling. No external POST allowed.
configuration.cache: HTTP cache disabled by interception, explicitly confirmed with CDP; repeat navigation reuses browser context/renderer, not warm HTTP cache.
configuration.cpu: CDP throttle1x; shared5-vCPU Linux host, per-run load and frame calibration retained. Not physical mobile CPU.
configuration.motion: No preference for measurement, real automatic motion; fallback check reduced motion.
configuration.lcp: Latest observed initial LCP after fonts-ready plus2s, before user interaction; not field p75 or whole-session final LCP.
configuration.cls: Maximum session window: gaps<=1s and span<=5s, excludes recent-input shifts; raw entries retained.
configuration.interaction: Trusted click to second rAF and EventTiming entries where emitted; not INP certification.
configuration.autoplay: Chromium no-user-gesture-required flag ensures native playback for end measurements. This is not a production autoplay-permission test.
configuration.payload: ResourceTiming sizes are browser-reported uncompressed fulfilled payloads, including overlapping media range requests; not unique asset size, gzip/CDN cost, or real startup network budget.

limits: VI-only lab sample; physical device, field data, HTTP warm-cache and throttled public network remain unverified. Three fresh-context/repeat pairs per route/device; video middle skipped by native seek.
